soundness_flags.label: def:holder-class; thm:beta-invariance; thm:oracle-high-s; oeq:deficient-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Conditional densities and regressions are defined only up to null sets, yet class membership requires pointwise-for-every-x Hölder properties without specifying jointly measurable Hölder versions; additionally, “Hölder order infinity with radius L” is undefined, while Theorem 1 quantifies over beta_prime=infinity.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Published chapter bibliographic record and abstract
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published chapter develops higher-order influence functions and minimax estimation of nonlinear functionals.
The paper derives a Hölder-model minimax CATE rate using localized fuzzy hypotheses and gives a local-polynomial estimator under high-level optimality conditions.
The paper gives adaptive nonparametric-functional bounds using finite-dimensional approximations and second-order U-statistics.
The paper studies black-box, structure-agnostic functional estimation and minimax lower bounds, contrasting it with function-space-structured higher-order estimation.
The paper defines a reflected exponential tilt around any interior point and states that its large-tilt limit yields a dose-response estimator across the treatment support.
The paper develops doubly robust nonparametric estimation of a continuous-treatment effect curve, including local-kernel asymptotics and bandwidth selection.
